annotations.text:
START HERE — Renovation Type page.

The popup becomes this page's first section. The destination route already exists:
/properties/[slug]/interiors/budget-groups/[groupId]

Today it shows a bare "Budget lines" table and a "← Interiors" back link, so this is a consolidation, not a new route.

Trade Scope — the 13 headings from Drew's Word template, each a narrative block a GC reads to bid.

The left rail exists because a bid needs ALL of them: written vs not-written at a glance. Nothing here is priced — pricing stays in section 1.

Finish Specs + Fixture Kit — the template's five tables, verbatim columns.

Columns differ per table (Paint has 5, Flooring has 2), which is why these are stored as {cols, rows} rather than fixed columns — same shape already used by scope_items.specs.

Reno Type Triggers — PROPERTY-level, not per type, because it's the rule that CHOOSES between types.

This is also the "Why Signature?" checklist from the earlier project mockup — same data, finally backed. The lower card shows the payoff on a unit.

Bid Sheet — the GC-facing output, Letter portrait at 96dpi (816x1056).

Blank ruled cells are where the GC writes prices; our numbers show as greyed reference only. This replaces mailing the Word doc.
